outcome: composition of infant gut microbiota (e.g., abundance of Enterococcus spp., Citrobacter spp., Clostridioides difficile, Bacteroidaceae, Enterococcaeae/Bacteriodaceae ratios, Enterobacterales/Bacteriodaceae ratios, Porphyromonadaceae)
cohort: 1313 Canadian infants from the CHILD Cohort Study were involved in this study.
finding: Prolonged hospital stay after birth is associated with infant gut dysbiosis.
mod_finding: The association between prolonged LOS and infant gut microbiota composition varied depending on the mode of birth (vaginal or caesarean) and factors like intrapartum antibiotic exposure and breastfeeding.
